Name: SH's Non-Hostile Bats for Custom Critters
Author: plurffle
Description:
[b]Before anything:[/b] Yes, I know that there are bats in the vanilla game, both hostile and non-hostile (the fruit bats), but I wanted more bats to just roam throughout Pelican Town and wouldn't hurt the player. They can be a bit confusing when you're playing in a map that allows monsters to spawn on your farm though-

This mod adds non-hostile bats with the use of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255/]spacechase0's Custom Critters mod[/url]﻿! They usually spawn when it's dark out, but they do have a small chance of showing up during the day. I don't think I made them spawn that much during the night (not as much as butterflies during the day), but you'll likely come across at least one in smaller maps.

How to Install:
1. Unzip the zip file.
2. Just drop the extracted folder in your Custom Critters folder. _(:3 」∠)_
